pmap frame/FTE descriptor validator: validates 16KiB-aligned paddr < 0xffffffffffffc000; resolves current/root FTE via direct window or sptm_phystokv fallback; checks FTE class == 1 and paddr within level entry size else panic 0x8000004. Returns {desc_va, paddr}.

AES-GCM context setup from algorithm descriptor: requires 16-byte key (AES-128) else -1; stores ops at ctx+0x68, key workspace at ctx+0x70, descriptor key at ctx+0x78; calls ops->prepare, sptm_gcm_ctx_init(000b0cc8), ops->keysched, builds GHASH table at ctx+0x80 (000b1140).

Loads key/IV into init state (state==1): length==0xc sets 12-byte GCM IV (8 bytes ctx+0x20, 4 ctx+0x28, counter 0x01000000 ctx+0x2c); else folds length bytes into GHASH state ctx+0x20 then XORs length block and hashes. Tail: copy counter, bump, state->2. Stack canary.

Streaming GCM update (in->out). Advances state 2->3 (000b2204); requires state 3 else 0xffffffbc; rejects overflowing byte count (ctx+0x60) with 0xffffffbd. Partial/leading block XOR + ghash_step + counter bump; bulk via sptm_aes_gcm_core(000afad0); trailing partial; updates ctx+0x60.

Formats the panic message into the per-CPU panic buffer (0xa28 at cpu+3), announces it on console, flags the panic record, then halts in an unbounded WFE spin. On format overflow emits "PANIC_BUF_SIZE..." truncation. Helpers sptm_snprintf(0xad278), serial, strlcpy_chk, guest_exit_handoff(0xa1374).

Formats a secondary panic frame into a 0xa28 stack buffer, copies into per-CPU panic buffer, hands off / breaks. Records panicking CPU; panics if violation flag not set. Helpers bzero(0xabb60), snprintf, record_panic_cpu(0xd6088), guest_exit_handoff.
